passages.quote:
This guide provides employers with an overview of the changes being introduced by the UK government around work experience. The guide covers changes such as:

mandatory work experience for all 16-19 year olds

the introduction of traineeships - a new programme bridging education and employment

the removal unnecessary red tape

the introduction of new ‘supported internships’ for young people with special needs
